Discover Your Soul Archetype

A personalized reflection on who you are, what you learned to carry, and how to integrate it all with self-trust.

How the reading works

Five placements, one living portrait

Using your birth date, time and place, this guide calculates where five classical luminaries sat in the tropical zodiac when you were born. Each one speaks to a different part of your inner life. Together they point toward a primary and supporting Soul Archetype: images of the strengths you already carry and the ones you are learning to trust.

No astrology knowledge is needed. All you need is your birth date, birth time if you know it, and birthplace. The positions are calculated for you from an astronomical ephemeris, and you receive a personalized six-page summary you can print or save as a PDF.

    A symbolic reading, not a diagnosis. Astrology is used here as a language for self-reflection. It is not an empirically validated psychological assessment, and nothing in your reading describes facts about your childhood, your relationships or your personality. Take what resonates and leave the rest.

    The twelve Soul Archetypes are original, Jungian-inspired images created for this summary. They are not an official classification from C. G. Jung.

    Step one

    Your birth details

    Your birth certificate is the most reliable source for your birth time. If you do not know it, you can still receive your complete six-page summary. The guide will tell you if any placement changed signs during your birth day.

    This version uses signs only. It does not calculate houses, the Ascendant or aspects.

    Birth date

    Birth time

    Without a birth time, the reading uses the sign each planet held for most of your birth day and tells you if any of them changed signs that day. The Moon is the placement most likely to be affected.
